commits.subject: Stop a corner hover from turning the page in a very short window

verification.command_or_steps: Unchanged code (HEAD aca4937), vite preview, Playwright Chromium 1440x160, #/p/45, mouse.move to a corner 3px inside both edges of .stf__block (steps:1), wait 100ms, mouse.move to window centre (steps:1), wait 1500ms, read location.hash
verification.notes: Book is a spread 56.5px wide (each page ~28px). BR #/p/45 -> #/p/46, TR -> #/p/46, BL -> #/p/42, TL -> #/p/42 (backward turn to spread 42-43, not 44 as the order expected, but still a turn). 1440x900 and 390x844: all four corners stay at #/p/45.

verification.command_or_steps: Same reproduction after the fix, all four corners at 1440x160, 1440x900, 390x844

1440x900 and 390x844: hover the BR and BL corners 5px inside, wait 400ms, compare screenshot to baseline; move to centre, wait 1500ms, compare again. Run on the base build (port 4616) and the fixed build (port 4615)
verification.notes: Fixed: 1440x900 BR shows fold + restores; 1440x900 BL shows fold + restores; 390x844 BR shows fold + restores; hash unchanged in all. 390x844 BL shows no hover fold, the same on the base build: by design, the existing isPointOnCorners patch keeps page-flip's original corners for hover previews, so a single page's left corners have no preview. Base 1440x900 BL screenshot showed no fold in that one run, probably screenshot timing; fixed showed it.

verification.command_or_steps: 1440x900 and 390x844, BR and BL: click the corner; drag the corner past the spine with 15 steps (portrait BR: to x=4, left of the page edge) and release; drag 40px and release. Base and fixed builds
verification.notes: Fixed matches base in every case. 1440x900: BR click/drag far -> #/p/46, BL click/drag far -> #/p/42, small drags -> #/p/45. 390x844: BR click/drag far -> #/p/46, BR small -> #/p/45, BL click/drag far -> #/p/44. Exception, on base too: 390x844 BL small 40px drag -> #/p/44 (turns back). Not caused by this change (hovering is false during drags); see open_issues.

verification.command_or_steps: 1440x160 #/p/45: click 다음 쪽, then 이전 쪽; reload, ArrowRight, then ArrowLeft
verification.notes: next -> #/p/46, prev -> #/p/44, ArrowRight -> #/p/46, ArrowLeft -> #/p/44 (#11 not regressed).

verification.command_or_steps: Playwright console messages, all levels, whole session
verification.notes: Only error: 404 for /_vercel/insights/script.js (Vercel analytics is absent on the local preview), on base and fixed builds alike. No page or JS errors.

verification.command_or_steps: cd web && npm test && npm run build

not_run_with_reasons: Hover-fold check for the top corners at 1440x900/390x844: only the bottom corners were screenshot-checked; the top corners were covered by the hash-only hover run (unchanged).
Touch/swipe was not tested: the order does not ask for it, and the change only affects stopMove calls made from inside showCorner (mouse hover).
open_issues: On the base build too: at 390x844 a 40px drag from the bottom-left corner turns back (#/p/45 -> #/p/44) instead of returning. Not caused by this change; may deserve its own issue.
On the base build too: in portrait the left corners show no hover preview (by design in the existing isPointOnCorners patch).
